synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — a real revenue/EBITDA inflection and light leverage set against deep, worsening cash burn with no disclosed runway.

bull_points.claim: Revenue is compounding — $3,419M (FY22) → $4,413M (FY25) → $5,304M LTM — and the name's 1y revenue growth of 22% is more than double the peer-median 9%, a fundamental it out-runs the comp set on.

bull_points.claim: The EBITDA trajectory has crossed into positive territory — consensus FY26E $92.3M and FY27E $187.1M direct EBITDA — so the 'NM' trailing EBITDA multiple reflects a company at an inflection, not a permanently loss-making model.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Estimates→Trends (FY26/FY27 consensus EBITDA, latest snapshot)

bull_points.claim: Quarterly EBITDA turned positive most recently (FY25 -$4M → FY26 +$34M) with gross margin lifting 7%→8%, evidence the margin turn is underway rather than promised.

On TEV/Revenue the name trades 0.4 vs a peer LOW of 0.7 and median 1.9 — below the cheapest peer — but this is a CONSENSUS framing, not a verdict: the peer set spans a 642x cap range ($478M–$306.6B) and is HETEROGENEOUS, so whether the sub-low-percentile discount is EARNED (thin/negative margins, high beta) or RESIDUAL (overshoot) is the human's call, not a clean benchmark read.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Trading Multiples (name row + Summary Statistics Low/Median/Mean/High)

bull_points.claim: Sell-side posture is constructive against a $9.56 close — mean/median target $17.00, 8 buys/outperforms vs 2 holds, 0 sells — a genuine gap between price and consensus fair value.
Balance sheet is lightly levered on a debt/equity basis (0.15) with modest net debt $170M against $812M equity, so the survival question is a cash-burn question, not an over-leverage one.

bear_points.claim: Cash generation is deeply negative and worsening — LTM levered FCF -$131.2M and LTM CFO -$489M — and with net debt $170M this is the REAL signal (not an optical timing quirk): both OCF and FCF are negative, so the company cannot self-fund and is burning cash against undisclosed runway.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Cash Flow 'Levered Free Cash Flow' [LTM 12 months Mar-31-2026]

bear_points.claim: The FY26 consensus path has collapsed across the board over six months — EBITDA 140.7 → 92.3 (net -34%), EBIT +162.0 → -103.3 (crossed zero), EPS (GAAP) +1.68 → -1.40 (crossed zero), Net Income +145 → -37.3 — a broad worsening, not a single line.

The stock fell -66% over 180 days (-82% relative to market), and the drawdown is discrete earnings gap-downs (2026-02-03 and 2026-05-06, both item 2.02) — the market re-priced on results, not on a shared sell-off.
The name dilutes steadily — shares +4.0% over ~1 year (329.3M → 342.4M) — a persistent per-share headwind atop the cash burn.

The negative-EBITDA implied-valuation math signals fragility: applying peer NTM-EBITDA multiples yields NEGATIVE implied equity (median -$966.75M), i.e. the EBITDA base does not yet support the enterprise on a peer-multiple basis.
